_about: John Strype (1643-1737), the documentary historian of the English Reformation, in the Clarendon Press collected edition: Ecclesiastical Memorials (1822, 3 vols in 6 parts), Annals of the Reformation (1824, 4 vols in 7 parts), the Lives of Parker (1821, 3 vols), Whitgift (1822, 3 vols), Grindal, Aylmer and Cheke (1821), and the Memorials of Cranmer in the Ecclesiastical History Society's edition (1848-1854, 3 vols). Volume and part numbers read off each title page. Much of each Appendix prints Latin records, so the OCR's share of common English words runs low. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
